Smaller text fits more of a session on the screen.
Send: Enter sends the message, and Shift+Enter on a hardware keyboard starts a new line. New line: Enter starts a new line and only the send button sends.
A trial: Ghostty\'s terminal core instead of xterm.js. The next terminal you open uses it.
The mode the New session sheet opens on. Changing it there is for that session only; Bypass is chosen there each time.

Not yet. Keep planning: the user wants to refine the plan before you start.
See the Claude Code or Codex sessions on your server, live, and answer them from here. Three steps.
Pair one more server. The ones you paired stay, and Home\'s chip switches between them.

On the computer where Claude Code runs, install the server package from the latest release (hypernova-server-….tar.gz), or clone the repository and run scripts/install-linux.sh. Installed already? Go on.
In a terminal on the server, run hypernova pair. It shows a QR code and a link under it.
Scan the code, or use the link

Point this phone\'s camera at the QR code, at home or over your VPN: it opens the server\'s own page (your browser warns once about the server\'s certificate: go on), which opens Hypernova and pairs. Or paste the link below.
No link on the clipboard. On the server, hypernova pair prints the link under the code: copy it and paste it here.
Your sessions are on their way. You can answer approvals, start sessions and follow along from here.
Your computer isn\'t showing a code.
On the local network your server takes a code only while it shows one. Run hypernova pair on it again and scan the new code.
